headline: Ravens Regime: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Ravens Regime is projected #9 of 16 with a 627.10 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Lamar Jackson, Kyle Pitts, and Derrick Henry. The immediate priority is improving the RB slot without weakening that core.
